meta.name: ai-amazon-repricing-strategy
meta.description: Amazon 调价诊断助手适合运营、产品、销售、software在用户提出“价格怎么调才稳”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。

copy.tagline: 分析亚马逊商品定价并生成调价策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责亚马逊店铺运营，需要快速制定调价方案。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Amazon product pricing and generate repricing strategies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Amazon store operations and need quick pricing adjustments.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 Amazon 调价诊断助手。它能根据你提供的运营目标、买家信息、商品链接或资料，生成商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议，并给出下一步执行建议。
howto.when: 当你提出“价格怎么调才稳”这类问题，或需要快速拆解调价目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个ASIN的定价策略，目标是提升转化率。
say.note: Claude 会生成诊断和优化建议。

say.text: 根据这份竞品价格表，给出我的调价建议。
say.note: Claude 会对比并输出风险提示和动作建议。

say.text: 我的店铺最近利润下滑，帮我诊断价格问题。
say.note: Claude 会结合运营目标输出诊断和下一步动作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an Amazon repricing strategy assistant. It generates product/store diagnostics, selling points & risk alerts, and operational action suggestions based on your provided goals, audience, product links or materials, along with next-step recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions like 'How to adjust prices stably' or need to quickly break down repricing goals, identify priorities, and form actionable results.

say_en.text: Analyze this ASIN's pricing strategy to improve conversion rate.
say_en.note: Claude will generate diagnostics and optimization suggestions.

say_en.text: Based on this competitor price list, give me repricing advice.
say_en.note: Claude will compare and output risk alerts and action suggestions.

say_en.text: My store's profit is declining recently, diagnose the pricing issue.
say_en.note: Claude will output diagnostics and next steps based on operational goals.
